messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Glossary for Latest Variable names
parts:
Hi Mark,

The glossary is based on https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html#4_Inspecting_the_results which provides the template. From there you need to take into account your custom script parameters. Feel free to send me the name of a specific variable and I'll decipher it for you to say what the value should represent. 

You can calculate MVPA by specifying decimals of an hour e.g. 09:15 to 10:05 for a time in the school day could would be qwindow = c(9.25,10.0833) and you can run a script per school if you have them separated that way. 
Alternatively there is the functionality to read in custom times for each individual which I think is available in the public release of GGIR now (Myself, Alex and others in our group paid for this functionality to be incorporated in GGIR with a grant). For this you need to make a .csv and call it in the script instead of the qwindow (qwindow = "C:/data/custom qwindows file.csv"). See attached a basic example. you can then put the ID's on the left with their specific school starting times with dates in the columns. This then gives you summary variables for those segments like the way you were already specifying qwindow previously. Please le me know if that covers your needs?

Thanks,
Ben
